title: Bob Doran
html_source: In the Dubliner’s story ‘The Boarding House’ Bob Doran is hoodwinked into Marriage by a mother and daughter who conspire together non-verbally. Mr Doran responds naturally to a young women affections and before his innocence is completely gone, marriage is soon demanded. Not surprising Bob’s marriage seems to be unhappy.
